caption: The drawing depicts a brown downspout or rain gutter, vertically oriented against a plain, off-white or beige background. At the top section, there is a rectangular basin-like structure bearing the number "1843" painted in yellow or gold. Just below this, the initials "JY" are similarly inscribed in yellow or gold on a slightly flared panel. Below that, on the main shaft of the downspout, there is a raised, embossed five-pointed star motif, also yellow or gold in color. The overall shape has angular, geometric lines, and a mounting bracket is visible on the top right and lower right side. On the lower left side of the drawing, the artist's signature, "IVAR JULIVS 1937," is written in red. The entire composition centers on this single architectural object, with no additional elements present.
title: Conductor Head
